idf.source: Campos-Aranda (2010), Ingenieria Investigacion y Tecnologia XI(2):179-188, Tabla 4, Guadalajara 14066

gapClassification.rule: a (persistente): f_low >= 0.25 and f_high >= 0.5*f_low; b (responde al drenaje): f_low >= 0.25 and f_high < 0.5*f_low; c (rara vez): f_low < 0.25

inletScenario.rule: capacity per drainage cell = C x (blocks with storm inlets on all frontages + 0.5 x some) / evaluated blocks of its AGEB (INEGI INV 2020); cells without INV data keep C
